content: The function EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode shall check whether the EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode API of the indexed transceiver driver is available by checking whether for this SwitchPortIdx the corresponding EthTrcv API is available. If this is not the case, the function shall return E_NOT_OK and if development error tracing is activated by EthSwtDevErrorDetect the ETHSWT_- E_INV_API shall be raised.
